title: BOX OF RETRO ITEMS INCLUDING U...
reason: Mixed 1950s to 70s glass and ceramics with a few saleable pieces and a possible uranium vase; nothing marked.
findings: Seven or eight mid-century style pieces: ruby flashed decanter with stopper, gilt bands and cut leaf decoration (looks 1950s to 60s Bohemian style); turquoise swung glass vase with a small foil label too small to read; apple-green ribbed glass vase (probably the 'uranium glass' piece in the title, cannot confirm without UV); brown glazed oval tray hand painted with turquoise and mustard fruit and fish motifs; pair of red painted figural bookends of seated figures in conical hats; milk glass bottle vase with applied amber vine and leaves (close-ups show a flake to the rim and a brownish deposit inside); red cased glass cylinder table lamp on a squat round base with a white interior. Maker not shown for any piece, no signatures, labels or marks legible. Value is a judgement from the photos only, not price-checked.
condition: Milk glass vase has a rim flake and residue inside; other pieces show no obvious chips in the photos; bookends and tray not seen closely; lamp wiring untested.
rescore_note: Unmarked mid-century glass and pottery (ruby decanter, swung vase, green vase, painted tray, red bookends, flaked milk glass vase, red glass lamp that may be a modern Ikea type); uranium claim unproven, no maker marks, so a mixed bag of low value pieces. Judged $30 to $80 band. Not price-checked (search limit hit).
